title: Getting there
description: Talk about how you travel and use going to for future plans.

introduction.headline: Talk about your journey
introduction.body: Learn words for transport and say how you are going to travel.
introduction.bodyIt: Impara il vocabolario dei mezzi di trasporto e di' come hai intenzione di viaggiare.
objectives: Use going to for travel plans
Read a short text about a journey

vocabulary.example: I am going to take the train.

vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Il nostro volo parte alle sei.

vocabulary.example: I need a ticket to Rome.
vocabulary.exampleTranslation: Mi serve un biglietto per Roma.

options: I am going to take the train.
I going to take the train.
I am go to take the train.
I am going take the train.
exercises.answer: I am going to take the train.
exercises.explanation: Use am/is/are + going to + verb for future plans.

exercises.promptIt: Completa: I need a ____ to Milan.
exercises.explanation: A ticket is what you buy to travel by train, bus, or plane.
Journey means the trip from one place to another.

review.tip: Say how you are going to travel next weekend using going to.
